title: Pentonic Gel Pen
desc: The Pentonic Gel Pen redefines the writing instrument space with its sleek, modern look and innovative features. Waterproof and refillable, driven by design with 0.6mm Japanese tip.

title: Pentonic Ball Pen
desc: The Pentonic Ball Pen elevates writing standards with 0.7mm and 1.0mm tips, writing over 1100 meters with feather-lite feel and smart minimalist black finish.

title: Pentonic Cipher Ball Pen
desc: Unleash your creativity with Pentonic Cipher! 0.5mm ball pen combining sleek style and precision, perfect for clean notes and fine writing.

title: Pentonic GRT Retractable Pen
desc: Pentonic GRT: A cutting-edge retractable ball pen with frictionless stroke, rapid dry ink, and double molding process for maximum comfort grip.

title: Pentonic Frost Gel Pen
desc: Pentonic Frost Gel offers superior writing with premium craftsmanship, refillable convenience, and a sleek durable matte frosted barrel finish.

title: Pentonic EVO Ball Pen
desc: The Pentonic EVO pen features sleek aerodynamic design, vibrant color barrel accents, and a refined 0.7mm tip for ultra-precise writing.

title: Pentonic CLR Transparent Pen
desc: Pentonic CLR Pen: where transparency meets precision. Translucent body, anti-slip contoured grip, and low viscosity ink flow in Blue, Black, and Red.

title: Pentonic GLITZ Pen
desc: Pentonic GLITZ pens are designed with metallic luxury finishes for students and professionals who value performance and premium aesthetics.

title: Pentonic B-RT Retractable Ball Pen
desc: Pentonic B-RT redefines your everyday writing with retractable click mechanism, low friction German ink, and velvety smooth matte grip.

title: Pentonic B-RT Pastel Edition
desc: Pentonic B-RT Pastel Edition: modern click retractable ball pen styled in soothing pastel barrel body hues with smudge-free German ink.

title: Pentonic Squad Animal Gel Pen
desc: Pentonic Squad combines trusted Pentonic gel smoothness with playful animal-inspired collectible caps and 0.6mm Japanese precision tip.

title: Pentonic GumStik Glue Stick
desc: Pentonic GumStik is the non-toxic, photo-safe smooth glue stick formula for clean school projects, scrapbooking, and office paperwork.

title: Pentonic Twistick Twist-Up Crayons
desc: Pentonic Twistick smooth vibrant twist-up wax crayons. No sharpening, no mess, just twist and color with rich, break-resistant pigmentation.

title: Pentonic Mechanical Pencil
desc: Pentonic Mechanical Pencil with 2 inbuilt Japanese leads, built-in eraser, and durable clutch mechanism for smooth break-free writing.

title: Pentonic Extra Dark Wooden Pencil
desc: Pentonic Extra Dark Wooden Pencil crafted for precision and elegance, offering intense dark graphite lines with smooth wood sharpening.

title: Pentonic Mathematical Geometry Box
desc: Pentonic Geometry Instrument Set with modern safe-pin compass, protractor, set squares, and scale for student precision and school safety.
